Part C: en preparación | Badge: [en preparación]
--------------------------------------------------
• Sack born at wet mill in 60 kg reference (ASM-150)
• Scale weight measured and recorded with 1 decimal
• Confirms drying lot (links to drying variables, ASM-096)
• Code bound from pre-printed batch (80 bits, ASM-094)
• Encrypted outbox buffers until cellular uplink (ASM-079)
• Responsible: Farmer (Farmer App, field pool, no MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="400" x="270" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s2_transit_center" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="in_transit_to_center
Part C: en viaje al acopio | Badge: [en viaje]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical custody on vehicle with transporter
• Open trip of type farm_to_center (ASM-159)
• GNSS fix recorded every 5 min en route (PD-110)
• Buffered offline during feeder road dead zones
• Reconnect: custody first, positions oldest first
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App, field pool)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="400" x="850" y="275" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3_center_accepted" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ecfdf5;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="at_center_accepted
Part C: en acopio (aceptado) | Badge: [aceptado]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical reception & quality acceptance at center
• Non-terminal: staged for outbound port transport
• Ready for assigned_to_trip to Buenaventura
• Receiver-authoritative: applied if pickup delayed (ASM-152)
• Responsible: Center Operator (Logistics App, TOTP MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="480" x="1490" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s4_center_rejected" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="at_center_rejected
Part C: en acopio (rechazado) | Badge: [rechazado]
--------------------------------------------------
• Physical reception rejected; reason is mandatory
• TERMINAL IN PILOT (ASM-151): does NOT travel to port
• Reprocessed coffee presented as NEW sack with NEW code
• Rejected sack preserves complete historical audit trail
• Responsible: Center Operator (Logistics App, TOTP MFA)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="480" x="1490" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start_unlabeled" parent="1" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d97706;strokeColor=#b45309;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Unlabeled Arrival

• TERMINAL STATE

• Port receiver reference recorded (ASM-057, ASM-077)
• Custody transfer to maritime export complete
• Responsible: Transporter (Transporter App)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="420" x="2870" y="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s7_port_rejected" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="delivered_at_port_rejected

[Farmer | recorded_at]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-20" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t2" edge="1" parent="1" source="s1_in_prep" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e40af;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#bfdbfe;fontStyle=1;" target="s2_transit_center" value="T2: picked_up_at_farm (custody)
[Transporter | recorded_at]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-20" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t3" edge="1" parent="1" source="s2_transit_center" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#065f46;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#a7f3d0;fontStyle=1;" target="s3_center_accepted" value="T3: received_at_center [accepted]
[Center Operator (MFA) | recorded_at]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-25" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1360" y="340" /> <mxPoint x="1360" y="290" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t4" edge="1" parent="1" source="s2_transit_center" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#991b1b;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#fecaca;fontStyle=1;" target="s4_center_rejected" value="T4: received_at_center [rejected, reason]
[Center Operator (MFA) | recorded_at]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="25" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1360" y="420" /> <mxPoint x="1360" y="580" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t3b" edge="1" parent="1" source="s1_in_prep" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#0d9488;strokeWidth=2;strokeDashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#0f766e;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#99f6e4;fontStyle=1;" target="s3_center_accepted" value="T3b: Offline Delayed Pickup Rule (ASM-152) — Receiver Authoritative: center reception applied even if pickup still buffered"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-10" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="470" y="275" /> <mxPoint x="470" y="195" /> <mxPoint x="1730" y="195" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t5_rej" edge="1" parent="1" source="start_unlabeled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#92400e;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#fde68a;fontStyle=1;" target="s4_center_rejected" value="T5: bound_at_center [accepted | rejected]
[Center Operator (MFA) | Reserve label >= 400 codes (ASM-153)]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="20" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1730" y="735" /> <mxPoint x="1730" y="695" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t5_acc" edge="1" parent="1" source="start_unlabeled" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="s3_center_accepted" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1785" y="775" /> <mxPoint x="2000" y="775" /> <mxPoint x="2000" y="320" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t6" edge="1" parent="1" source="s3_center_accepted" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e40af;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#bfdbfe;fontStyle=1;" target="s5_transit_port" value="T6: departed_to_port (custody)
[Transporter | assigned_to_trip]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-20" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1970" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="2100" y="320" /> <mxPoint x="2100" y="340" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t7" edge="1" parent="1" source="s5_transit_port" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#065f46;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#a7f3d0;fontStyle=1;" target="s6_port_accepted" value="T7: delivered_at_port [accepted]
[Transporter | receiver_reference]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-25" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2640" y="330" /> <mxPoint x="2750" y="330" /> <mxPoint x="2750" y="290" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge_t8" edge="1" parent="1" source="s5_transit_port" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#991b1b;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;labelBorderColor=#fecaca;fontStyle=1;" target="s7_port_rejected" value="T8: delivered_at_port [rejected, reason]
[Transporter | receiver_reference]"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="25" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="2640" y="420" /> <mxPoint x="2750" y="420" /> <mxPoint x="2750" y="580" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_events" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;" value="FIVE NON-STATE-CHANGING EVENTS (DOCS SEC 3.2)

These events record operational milestones and corrections with date, time, and responsible,
but do not alter the lifecycle state of the sack:

1. arrived_at_center:
 Transporter arrives at collection center yard and initiates physical handover.
 Records recorded_at on transporter phone and links open trip to center gate arrival (A10 sec 7).

2. assigned_to_trip:
 Collection-center operator stages accepted sacks onto an outbound center_to_port trip.
 Required guard condition before departed_to_port can be executed by transporter.

3. code_replaced:
 A damaged or illegible physical label is replaced with a fresh code from the center reserve.
 The retired code is marked void in sack_codes and permanently returns 'not found' at lookup.

4. weight_corrected:
 Compensating event correcting scale typographical error. Must be recorded by the same role
 and scope that entered original, citing mandatory reason (ASM-151). Retains full audit history.

5. outcome_corrected:
 Compensating event correcting reception outcome error (e.g. misclassified rejection).
 Same role, scope, and reason rule applies (ASM-151).

Append-Only Immutability Contract:
Zero events are edited or deleted. Every physical act is persisted immutably in sack_event_log.
State is derived by replaying history." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="750" width="1040" x="40" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;" value="OFFLINE ORDERING & TIMESTAMP RECONCILIATION (ASM-152, SEC 3.3, SEC 4)

Every mobile and field actor operates offline on mountain roads. Events reach AWS out of sequence.
Four deterministic rules govern state resolution:

Rule 1: Refuse Only What Caller Cannot Do
 API rejects requests only for invalid credentials/role, unknown/void code, or schema invalidity.
 Once an event represents a physical act that already occurred, it is unconditionally persisted.

Rule 2: Order by Time of the Act (Deterministic Fold)
 Current sack state is recomputed from scratch by replaying the complete event log ordered strictly
 by recorded_at ASC, then event_id ASC. Result is mathematically invariant to network arrival order!

Rule 3: Physical Receiver is Authoritative
 A custody transition recorded by the physical holder (T3, T4, T7, T8) is applied immediately even if
 upstream departure or pickup is still queued in a disconnected phone buffer. Missing steps flagged.

Rule 4: Pre-Registration Events Wait in Pending State
 An event arriving for an issued code prior to its sack_registered upload is held in pending status
 and applied automatically when the registration drains from the farmer's outbox.

Timestamp Rules (Sec 4):
• recorded_at: Device UTC timestamp to millisecond taken at moment of physical act.
 Formatted in America/Bogota (UTC-5) for display (ASM-007).
• received_at: Server UTC timestamp applied by API upon durable persistence in DynamoDB.
• Clock Skew Check: If recorded_at > received_at + 5 min, flagged as phone clock ahead (PD-151)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="750" width="1080" x="1110" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_stores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=16;" value="DATA SCHEMA & STORE ARCHITECTURE (DOCS SEC 4, SEC 10) [BOX D04, D06]

Mandatory Event Record Schema (Sec 4):
• event_id: UUID idempotency key generated on device (A10 sec 2)
• event_type: Transition event or non-state-changing event type
• sack_codes: List of Crockford Base32 sack codes covered in batch act
• trip_id: Trip reference (empty for sack_registered)
• recorded_at / received_at: Device act timestamp / API persistence time
• responsible_subject_id / role: Opaque pseudonym & Cognito role (ASM-091)
• device_id / center_id: App installation UUID & collection center ID
• latitude / longitude: GNSS fix coordinates for transporter custody acts
• weight_kg / drying_lot_id: Measured weight & drying lot identifier
• outcome / reason / receiver_reference: Status, rationale, port receipt ref

DynamoDB Store Topology (On-Demand Mode, KMS Customer Keys):
• sack_event_log: PK event_id | Immutable event log | KMS 'records' | Streams enabled
• sacks: PK sack_id | GSI sack_code, farm_id | Current state, version, flags | KMS 'records'
• sack_history: PK sack_id, SK recorded_at#event_id | Deterministic fold source | KMS 'records'
• trips: PK trip_id | Transporter custody legs & vehicles | KMS 'records'
• transport_positions: PK trip_id, SK sequence_no | 5-min GNSS fixes | KMS 'telemetry' (PD-110)
• buyer_view: PK sack_code | Projected public view | KMS 'public_view' (ASM-154)

Disaster Recovery Objectives (Sec 9, ASM-157, PD-153):
• RPO = 15 min: sack-exporter streams JSON Lines to S3 export prefix (ADR-001) every 60 s;
 CloudWatch alarm fires if iterator age > 5 min.
• RTO = 4 h: Public lookup runs serverless via CloudFront + Lambda URL + buyer_view;
 completely decoupled from application API!" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="750" width="1120" x="2220" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
FIVE NON-STATE-CHANGING EVENTS (DOCS SEC 3.2)
These events record operational milestones and corrections with date, time, and responsible,
but do not alter the lifecycle state of the sack:
1. arrived_at_center:
Transporter arrives at collection center yard and initiates physical handover.
Records recorded_at on transporter phone and links open trip to center gate arrival (A10 sec 7).
2. assigned_to_trip:
Collection-center operator stages accepted sacks onto an outbound center_to_port trip.
Required guard condition before departed_to_port can be executed by transporter.
3. code_replaced:
A damaged or illegible physical label is replaced with a fresh code from the center reserve.
The retired code is marked void in sack_codes and permanently returns 'not found' at lookup.
4. weight_corrected:
Compensating event correcting scale typographical error. Must be recorded by the same role
and scope that entered original, citing mandatory reason (ASM-151). Retains full audit history.
5. outcome_corrected:
Compensating event correcting reception outcome error (e.g. misclassified rejection).
Same role, scope, and reason rule applies (ASM-151).
Append-Only Immutability Contract:
Zero events are edited or deleted. Every physical act is persisted immutably in sack_event_log.
State is derived by replaying history.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(148, 163, 184), rgb(87, 100, 118));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1050px; height: 1px; padding-top: 901px; margin-left: 1097px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1e293b, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
OFFLINE ORDERING & TIMESTAMP RECONCILIATION (ASM-152, SEC 3.3, SEC 4)
Every mobile and field actor operates offline on mountain roads. Events reach AWS out of sequence.
Four deterministic rules govern state resolution:
Rule 1: Refuse Only What Caller Cannot Do
API rejects requests only for invalid credentials/role, unknown/void code, or schema invalidity.
Once an event represents a physical act that already occurred, it is unconditionally persisted.
Rule 2: Order by Time of the Act (Deterministic Fold)
Current sack state is recomputed from scratch by replaying the complete event log ordered strictly
by recorded_at ASC, then event_id ASC. Result is mathematically invariant to network arrival order!
Rule 3: Physical Receiver is Authoritative
A custody transition recorded by the physical holder (T3, T4, T7, T8) is applied immediately even if
upstream departure or pickup is still queued in a disconnected phone buffer. Missing steps flagged.
Rule 4: Pre-Registration Events Wait in Pending State
An event arriving for an issued code prior to its sack_registered upload is held in pending status
and applied automatically when the registration drains from the farmer's outbox.
Timestamp Rules (Sec 4):
• recorded_at: Device UTC timestamp to millisecond taken at moment of physical act.
Formatted in America/Bogota (UTC-5) for display (ASM-007).
• received_at: Server UTC timestamp applied by API upon durable persistence in DynamoDB.
• Clock Skew Check: If recorded_at > received_at + 5 min, flagged as phone clock ahead (PD-151).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(148, 163, 184), rgb(87, 100, 118));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1090px; height: 1px; padding-top: 901px; margin-left: 2207px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1e293b;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1e293b, #c3ccdc); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
DATA SCHEMA & STORE ARCHITECTURE (DOCS SEC 4, SEC 10) [BOX D04, D06]
Mandatory Event Record Schema (Sec 4):
• event_id: UUID idempotency key generated on device (A10 sec 2)
• event_type: Transition event or non-state-changing event type
• sack_codes: List of Crockford Base32 sack codes covered in batch act
• trip_id: Trip reference (empty for sack_registered)
• recorded_at / received_at: Device act timestamp / API persistence time
• responsible_subject_id / role: Opaque pseudonym & Cognito role (ASM-091)
• device_id / center_id: App installation UUID & collection center ID
• latitude / longitude: GNSS fix coordinates for transporter custody acts
• weight_kg / drying_lot_id: Measured weight & drying lot identifier
• outcome / reason / receiver_reference: Status, rationale, port receipt ref
DynamoDB Store Topology (On-Demand Mode, KMS Customer Keys):
• sack_event_log: PK event_id | Immutable event log | KMS 'records' | Streams enabled
• sacks: PK sack_id | GSI sack_code, farm_id | Current state, version, flags | KMS 'records'
• sack_history: PK sack_id, SK recorded_at#event_id | Deterministic fold source | KMS 'records'
• trips: PK trip_id | Transporter custody legs & vehicles | KMS 'records'
• transport_positions: PK trip_id, SK sequence_no | 5-min GNSS fixes | KMS 'telemetry' (PD-110)
• buyer_view: PK sack_code | Projected public view | KMS 'public_view' (ASM-154)
Disaster Recovery Objectives (Sec 9, ASM-157, PD-153):
• RPO = 15 min: sack-exporter streams JSON Lines to S3 export prefix (ADR-001) every 60 s;
CloudWatch alarm fires if iterator age > 5 min.
• RTO = 4 h: Public lookup runs serverless via CloudFront + Lambda URL + buyer_view;
completely decoupled from application API!
